_comment: Duck Radar sources. Edit freely. 'builder' = what people ship (models, agents, local LLM); 'creator' = what people make (AI video/content, viral tools). Reddit is fetched token-free via the public .json API. web_queries are searched by the warm Claude session at curate time (covers TikTok, which has no easy public API).

creator: trending AI on TikTok this week
viral AI video tool this week
builder: biggest open-source LLM or AI model release this week
